formal_statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (u v : List Bool → List Bool) (h : List Bool × List Bool → Bool), PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) u → PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) v → PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair Computability.encodeBool h → ∃ j : ℕ, PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInTime (fun x : List Bool => x) Computability.encodeBool (fun z : List Bool => h (List.replicate (2 ^ ((u z).length ^ k) + k) true ++ false :: u z, v z)) (fun n : ℕ => 2 ^ (n ^ j) + j)
plain_statement: If u, v are polynomial-time and h is a polynomial-time test of pairs, then z -> h(1^(2^(|u z|^k)+k) 0 (u z), v z) is decided in time 2^(n^j)+j for some j. Generalises the library's exponential hierarchy helper; folklore padding. Needed by L-meta-016.
title: A polynomial-time test after exact exponential padding runs in exponential time
